# UPchieve Changelog, week of Aug 2 to Aug 8, 2026

*Generated by Claude from merge-request and commit activity. Details may be inaccurate; check the linked MR or ask the author.*

Last deploys: high-line Aug 7, subway Aug 7. The subway deploy carried the backlog that last week's digest had as merged or approved.

**Status key:** 🚀 Launched (live to everyone) | 🧪 Experimental (in production, behind a feature flag) | 🎁 Merged (ships next deploy) | ✅ Approved (reviewed, not yet merged) | 👀 In review (needs review)

---

## Postgres read replica

A replica of the production database, so dev, testing, and debugging run against realistic data, and as the start of an analytics environment.

- 🚀 **Subscriber setup and post-migration publication maintenance:** the subscription created on the replica, with the README walking through creating the slot and verifying it on both ends ([subway !2804](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2804)); a script that finds every `upchieve` table not already in the publication, adds it, and refreshes the subscription, run automatically after migrations so a newly added table starts replicating ([subway !2787](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2787)). *Alex Lindsay*

## Student → Volunteer (S2V)

Lets a student become a volunteer coach on the same account, switching modes instead of creating a second one, so they can earn verified volunteer service hours.

- **Let the person signing up through a referral link choose their account type.** Which signup flow the link opened was decided by the referrer's legacy role, so a student who later added coach mode could only ever refer students. That blocks an S2V account from becoming an UPchieve ambassador, which is an accolade for recruiting volunteers. The choice now sits with the person signing up rather than the referrer, so recruiters keep one link. 🐛 [#693](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/693): ✅ the account-type choice in the signup flow ([high-line !1819](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1819)); ✅ `userType` no longer returned by the referring-user API ([subway !2842](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2842)). *Jamie Kasulis*
- ✅ **Pin the avatar menu's caret to the end of the row.** The sidebar's avatar, name, role, and caret row was a CSS grid with fixed `fr` tracks, and `fr` tracks size against each other and their content, so a shorter role label shrank its column and pulled the caret in with it. The row is flex now, with the avatar taking the slack, so the caret stays flush against the sidebar edge whatever the label says. ([high-line !1759](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1759)) *Macy Lam*

## End-to-end test suite

A browser test suite that drives high-line against a real subway, plus the work to make it run in CI.

- 🚀 **Skip the session-notification test on Mobile Chrome.** It had gone flaky on that browser only, and the suite blocks merges. ([high-line !1823](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1823)) *Jamie Kasulis*

## Quick wins, fixes, chores, and other small things

- 🚀 **Record whether we have a high school coach's school**, which the peer-to-peer team asked for to target future outreach campaigns. ([high-line !1807](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1807)) *Kasozi Wilson*
- 🚀 **Send a coach's whole certification list to PostHog as one array property.** Certifications went up one property per subject, so `prealgebra: true` if prealgebra was unlocked, which means a flag or a Gleap rule cannot ask "has any of these certifications". They now also go up as a single `certifications` array. Both forms are sent for now, since existing flags and Gleap rules still target the old way. ([high-line !1820](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1820)) *Jamie Kasulis*
- 🚀 **High school student coaches can pick up college sessions again.** College sessions are back in their open-sessions list, they get session notifications for those again, and the hourly texting job no longer filters them out. The `hs-students-barred-from-coaching-college-subjects` flag is switched off in PostHog and gone from both repos. ([subway !2828](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2828); [high-line !1799](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1799)) *Jamie Kasulis*
- 🚀 **Volunteer dashboard styling:** the caret that opens the locked-sessions menu on the "Waiting Students" card realigned, and the gap under the third card closed up ([high-line !1821](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1821)). *Alex Lindsay*
- 🧪 **Students can send an essay in and get it reviewed by a staff member.** An extension of the work on whether students value human tutors. A student sees the offer on the dashboard, submits the essay with its purpose, the prompt, and any extra context, and picks what they want looked at. The submission is held in Redis, a PostHog event fires a webhook into an internal staff Slack channel, and a staff member opens it from a new admin list and detail page and emails the student directly. The Redis hash gets deleted when the experiment ends. Rolled out to 10% of students active since January 1. ([`async-essay-review`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/806269)): the submission endpoint, the essay-review service, and the admin routes ([subway !2848](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2848)); the student modal, the submission view, and the two admin pages ([high-line !1827](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1827)); the flag read from toggle flags instead of payload flags ([high-line !1829](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1829)). *Trey Stevens*
- 🧪 **Delay some sessions on a coach's dashboard to protect the time of coaches with rare certifications.** A coach certified in a high-priority subject sees those sessions immediately and every other session 30 seconds later, by which point one of the other available coaches may have taken it. The high-priority list is Physics 1, AP Physics 1, Calculus AB, AP Calculus AB, College Apps, SAT Reading, and Application Essays. Rolled out to everyone in the "Dogfood Eaters" cohort, plus 30% of coaches who are in both the "Ready to coach" and "High-level subject certification (dashboard algo experiment)" cohorts and have been active since July 1. ([`dashboard-algorithm`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/798742)) ([high-line !1808](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1808)) *Jamie Kasulis*
- **Screen image uploads with PhotoDNA before they are stored.** [#658](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/658): ✅ session photos upload through the backend ([subway !2757](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2757)); ✅ the backend receives volunteer photo IDs ([subway !2758](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2758)); 👀 the middleware itself, which screens the upload before it is stored ([subway !2840](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2840)); 👀 the infraction's session id made nullable, since a quarantined volunteer photo ID does not come from a session ([subway !2832](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2832)); 👀 a teacher told which safety policy a rejected assignment attachment tripped, instead of the upload just failing ([high-line !1814](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1814)). *Liseidy Bueno*
- 🚀 **Simplify how a teacher's class view calculates student assignment completion.** Building the completion map ran through several methods that were hard to follow; the student assignments are now attached to the assignments directly. ([high-line !1803](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1803)) *Alex Lindsay*
- ✅ **A Vuetify form checkbox**, continuing the move of the component library onto Vuetify. ([high-line !1741](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1741)) *Liseidy Bueno*

### Fixes

- **Upload the files a teacher attaches when editing an assignment.** The edit modal accepted attachments and dropped them, because the upload was a separate request from the assignment update. Create and edit now run through one upsert on both sides. 🐛 [#653](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/653): 🚀 class and student selection in the modal simplified to the single class it always is ([high-line !1804](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1804)); 🚀 the edited assignment updated in the list afterwards, which was reading `response.assignment` instead of `response.data.assignment` ([high-line !1810](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1810)); ✅ one `upsertAssignment` query behind both create and edit ([subway !2830](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2830)); ✅ a `PUT /assignment` endpoint on top of it ([subway !2835](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2835)); ✅ a separate endpoint for assigning to multiple classes, since the old one took the selected students and assigned them even when they were not in the class, so a teacher saw students on an assignment who were not in it ([subway !2829](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2829)); ✅ file upload folded into the backend upsert ([subway !2837](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2837)); ✅ a check that the teacher owns the class or assignment, which any teacher could previously edit ([subway !2836](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2836)); ✅ the now-unused assignment methods and routes removed ([subway !2838](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2838)); ✅ an `AssignmentService` on the front end, since creating from the teacher dashboard had already diverged and skipped the file upload ([high-line !1805](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1805)); ✅ the service pointed at the new endpoints ([high-line !1811](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1811)); ✅ file upload folded into the service's upsert request ([high-line !1812](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1812)); ✅ the views switched over to the service ([high-line !1806](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1806)); ✅ the modal held open under a loading overlay while the request runs, so a failure no longer closes it and discards the teacher's work ([high-line !1813](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1813)). *Alex Lindsay*
- **Let a coach say "I can't find my school" instead of forcing a choice.** Last week's school requirement stopped student volunteers who could not find their school from finishing onboarding, which caught a lot of private-school coaches. The option does not persist anything, it just leaves the school association undefined so they can move on. Dual-role coaches who already have a school from their student account see "We already have your school on file from your student account" instead of a school search, and saving never touches their `schoolId`. Everyone else still has to pick a school or say they cannot find it, and that requirement now also applies to editing background info in the profile, which previously let the field save blank. 🚀 the front end ([high-line !1825](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1825)); ✅ `studentSchoolId` added to the user object so the front end can tell a dual-role coach already has one ([subway !2851](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2851)). *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Send the ambassador congrats email only after five referred volunteers.** The count included every referred user, so a student who had recruited five students got congratulated on an ambassador milestone they had not hit. It now counts referred users with the volunteer role. 🐛 [#692](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/692) ([subway !2841](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2841)) *Jamie Kasulis*
- 🚀 **Show one "Applications" option in the session-history subject filter.** Two College Counseling subjects share the display name, so the dropdown listed it twice. 🐛 [#674](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/674) ([high-line !1798](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1798)) *sammy nave*
- 🚀 **Re-enable the session-history subject dropdown.** The dedupe above built its list outside the `.map()` callback but read `topic`, which only exists inside it, so the computed threw and the filter came up disabled. The dedupe moved inside the callback. Both changes went out in the same deploy, so nobody saw the broken state. 🐛 [#690](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/690) ([high-line !1816](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1816)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Keep `[object Object]` out of the session-history URL.** The filtered-session list was stored inside the `filters` object, which gets serialized into the query string, so an array of session objects ended up in the URL. It now lives outside the filters. 🐛 [#678](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/678) ([high-line !1802](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1802)) *sammy nave*
- 🚀 **Hide the favorite button on your own sessions.** Sessions you coached show up in your session history when you are in student mode, so you could favorite yourself as a good coach. 🐛 [#677](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/677) ([high-line !1801](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1801)) *sammy nave*
- 🚀 **Treat a grade level of "Other" as ineligible on the backend.** Front-end signup already blocked it; the eligibility check now sends these users to the request form instead. 🐛 [#671](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/671) ([subway !2824](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2824)) *Trey Stevens*
- 🚀 **Log the reason an SSO registration failed.** Google SSO registration was returning `Unknown server error`, which is the generic message you get when nothing is passed to `failureRedirect`, and the logs said nothing more. ([subway !2827](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2827)) *Alex Lindsay*
- **Inject dev secrets from Doppler instead of copying them into a `.env` file.** Starting the local server pulls the dev secrets with a Doppler service token scoped to read them, held in the 1Password engineering vault, so nothing lands unencrypted on disk. You need read access to that vault and a 1Password CLI login; you do not need a Doppler login. 🚀 the Node server ([subway !2849](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2849)); 🎁 the Vite server ([high-line !1824](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1824)). *Alex Lindsay*
- 🧪 **Show an approved photo ID as completed on the volunteer checklist.** `photoIdStatus` was stripped from the user object, so "Proof of identity" fell back to its default state, as if nothing had been uploaded. The old checklist hid the safety card once a volunteer was approved, so there was never anywhere to show it; the combined checklist stays up until onboarding finishes too, so now there is. The field is now always returned, but the visible fix only reaches coaches on the combined checklist: everyone with both a student and a coach role and no school partner, plus 15% of coach-only accounts. 🐛 [#676](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/676) ([`combined-onboarding-checklist`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/660994)) ([subway !2843](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2843)) *Alex Lindsay*
- ✅ **Spell `America/New_York` with an underscore in the NTHS chapter-status job.** `America/New York` is not a valid IANA zone, so moment-timezone silently fell back. Fixed in all three spots, matching every other job in the file. ([subway !2844](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2844)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 👀 **Remove the college journey modal from the student dashboard.** 🐛 [#666](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/666) ([high-line !1826](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1826)) *Liseidy Bueno*
- 👀 **Keep the unread-DM filter on when you come back from a session.** `hasUnreadDMs` is in the query now, so the back button returns to the filtered list instead of the main messages page. 🐛 [#657](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/657) ([high-line !1828](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1828)) *Liseidy Bueno*
- 👀 **Compare moderation confidence scores on the scale they actually come back on.** Two thresholds were multiplied by 100 before being compared against a 0-to-1 score, which put them out of reach, so neither filter ever matched: rude gestures against Comprehend's toxicity score ([subway !2845](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2845)), and addresses against the address-detection model's confidence rating ([subway !2846](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2846)). Found while triaging [#668](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/668). *Ben Wheeler*
- 👀 **Let `PGHOST`/`PGPORT` point the db scripts at another database.** The `db:` scripts, `reset_db.sh`, and `.pgpass` hardcoded `localhost:5432`, so with two checkouts running, a migration from the second one quietly landed in the first one's database. `.pgpass` had the port hardcoded too, so it silently failed to authenticate anywhere but 5432 and now wildcards it. Defaults are unchanged. ([subway !2852](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2852)) *Ben Wheeler*
